verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a dedicated Auditor API for conducting audits inside Vanta. Auditors can list the audits assigned to their firm, pull controls and evidence, manage information requests (IRLs), and review the resources and personnel in scope for each engagement. Marketing also claims seamless auditor collaboration in the platform, so auditors work in-product with engagement-scoped access rather than through emailed files. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the auditor-facing UI and its role/permission scoping, details of the in-app request/comment workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it replaces email-based evidence exchange.
